## Pipeline Generations

The database on this site is the first of five generations. Each generation is
built from the one before it, and each has its own site. Only the pilot
generation is split per source, because that is the stage where the five data
providers still look like five different databases.

| # | Generation | What it adds | Site |
|---|------------|--------------|------|
| 1 | pilot   | one database per source, parsed from the provider's own export with as little interpretation as possible | this site, and the four below |
| 2 | slim    | the shared seven-table schema, plus flags for quality, duplicates, detection limits and derived values | [multised-slim](https://seafood-hazards.github.io/multised-slim/) |
| 3 | clean   | the flags applied: unusable rows removed, units and names harmonised, sites geo-enriched | [multised-clean](https://seafood-hazards.github.io/multised-clean/) |
| 4 | merged  | all five sources in one database, with cross-source duplicates resolved | [multised-merged](https://seafood-hazards.github.io/multised-merged/) |
| 5 | refined | a mart cut from the merged database for the pristine and background work | [multised-refined](https://seafood-hazards.github.io/multised-refined/) |

### Pilot sites

One site per data source, each documenting that provider's own schema and the
corrections applied to it.

| Source | Coverage | Site |
|--------|----------|------|
| Mareano   | Norway, IMR cruises                            | [mareano-pilot](https://seafood-hazards.github.io/mareano-pilot/) |
| Vannmiljø | Norway                                         | this site |
| ICES-DOME | International, rich sediment composition data  | [ices-dome-pilot](https://seafood-hazards.github.io/ices-dome-pilot/) |
| MUDAB     | Germany                                        | [mudab-pilot](https://seafood-hazards.github.io/mudab-pilot/) |
| 4Demon    | Belgium, Baltic and North Sea                  | [4demon-pilot](https://seafood-hazards.github.io/4demon-pilot/) |
